notes:
Snapshot: SMB consumer-chat startup. Single founder (Maya Chen) leading product + eng. Signed up self-serve, picked hosted API for speed. Primary concern is per-conversation cost; wants conversational latency <200-400ms perceived (frontend target) and predictable per-message pricing for a pay-as-you-grow flow. Initial integration used JavaScript SDK; only a tiny fraction of expected calls executed after kickoff (integration looked straightforward, but team deprioritized after they got OpenAI credits).

Sales/CS notes: 
- Maya quote from 2026-02-12: 'If we can get similar quality at half the cost, we'll move.'
- Technical note from SE (Priya): no CORS or auth issues; sampled prompts were long (avg 1200 tokens) — cost could be reduced with system prompt truncation + streaming.
- Competition: OpenAI chosen for initial experiments because of dev familiarity + promotional credits; Anthropic mentioned as possible alternative for safety-focused responses.
- Risk signals: low usage after provisioning + mention of promotional credits elsewhere -> likely to churn if we don't demonstrate cost/perf delta quickly.
- Positive: liked Redwood's model catalog and host-managed fallback profiles. Interested in recommendation for smaller context-window models for cheap fallbacks.

Suggested quick wins: targeted report showing per-conversation cost with prompt edits, 1-hour office hours to pair on streaming + prefix caching suggestions, one-off 5k token credit to trigger real traffic and renew engagement.
use_case_summary: Primary app: consumer-facing conversational assistant inside a mobile app with light personalization (embeddings for memory). Expected baseline traffic: 50-300 active users first 3 months (bursting patterns), peak concurrency low (<5 rps). Latency SLO: perceived response <400ms on median for single-turn chat; willing to accept higher tail for long generation. Needs hosted API (no infra ops). Wants model quality comparable to mainstream LLMs; cost sensitivity high. Would like routing/fallback: use smaller open-model for low-cost responses and larger model for high-value conversations. No current enterprise compliance needs beyond SSO and audit logs.
